name: LV Design Studio
tagline: Low-voltage electrical design in one workspace.
summary: An open-source, offline-first workspace for single-line diagrams, load schedules, electrical calculations, drawings and reports. Projects remain under the engineer's control as local files.
engineeringStatus: The calculations are first-pass design checks, not a substitute for an engineer's verified study. Built-in cable values are approximate references until replaced with manufacturer data, and some study methods are intentionally simplified. Nothing in the app constitutes approval by an electrical authority.

capabilities.title: Network and schedules
capabilities.description: Build board hierarchies, load schedules and single-line diagrams from the same project data.

capabilities.title: Electrical calculations
capabilities.description: Check cable and breaker sizing, voltage drop, short circuit, earthing, protection coordination, transformers, generators and power factor correction.

capabilities.title: Drawings and deliverables
capabilities.description: Prepare drawing sheets, schedules, bills of quantities and engineering reports from the current design model.

capabilities.title: Independent cross-checks
capabilities.description: Compare selected studies with optional OpenDSS and pandapower engines installed on your own computer.

getInvolved.intro: LV Design Studio is developed in the open. Follow the releases, report what does not work, and share the engineering data that improves the built-in references.

items.title: Follow the project
items.description: Follow the developer on LinkedIn for news about new releases.

items.title: Report a problem
items.description: Open an issue with the steps that led to the problem. In the app, Help has Copy error log, which gives the details to paste in.

items.title: Share engineering data
items.description: Authority rules, manufacturer cable and breaker data and schedule formats can be reviewed for the built-in references. Name the source document so that it can be checked.

items.title: Contribute code
items.description: The source is open under the MIT or Apache-2.0 licence. The README gives the setup and the test commands.
